notes.title: Retirement of Negative: The Way of Shinobi from the Steam Store
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone,[/p][p]We’d like to inform you that Negative: The Way of Shinobi will be retired from the Steam Store and will no longer be available for purchase soon.[/p][p]It's your last chance to get it![/p][p]If you already own the game, don’t worry — it will remain in your Steam Library, and you will still be able to download and enjoy it at any time.[/p][p]Thank you so much for supporting the project and for being part of our journey.[/p][p]Art Games Studio[/p]

notes.title: Negative: The Way of Shinobi - just released!
notes.content:
Hello everyone who likes Ninja world!

So now you can get closer to Ninja world and try your skills to beat this game!

Don't forget to add Negative: The Way of Shinobi to your wishlist and buy the game with 20% premiere discount!
